meta.name: chrome-automation
meta.description: 网页开发工程师与运营专员在需要自动化现有 Chrome 浏览器时必用！通过 CDP 协议无缝接管当前浏览器，自动配置环境并实时可视化执行任务。完美保留登录状态，一键完成复杂网页自动化流程，让繁琐操作自动化。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接管当前 Chrome 自动完成网页操作，保留登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要在网页上重复执行操作且需要保留登录状态。
copy.tagline_en: Automate tedious web flows in an existing Chrome with login preserved.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely repeat manual steps in a browser and need to stay logged in.

howto.what: Claude 会先自动检查并安装 agent-browser 等依赖，再通过 CDP 接管你当前的 Chrome 浏览器，在窗口里打开页面、截图、填表、点击，并把浏览器状态截图报给你。
howto.when: 当你要求自动化现有 Chrome 浏览器里的操作（如网页搜索、填表等），或提到 chrome-automation 技能时触发。

say.text: 用我现在的 Chrome 打开小红书并搜索 labubu
say.note: 会打开页面、截图给你看

say.text: 帮我自动填写这个网页表单并提交
say.note: 填写后按 Enter 并截图结果

say.text: 截一张当前浏览器页面的图给我
say.note: 截图保存并说明页面内容

howto.what_en: Claude first auto-checks and installs the agent-browser dependencies, then takes over your running Chrome via CDP to open pages, take screenshots, fill forms and click, reporting the browser state back with screenshots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to automate actions in your existing Chrome browser, such as web search or filling forms, or mention the chrome-automation skill.

say_en.text: Open Xiaohongshu in my current Chrome and search for labubu
say_en.note: Opens the page and screenshots it for you

say_en.text: Fill in this web form for me and submit it
say_en.note: Fills the fields, presses Enter, screenshots the result

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current browser page for me
say_en.note: Saves the screenshot and describes the page
